cites.quote: Default for name ties: compare doctor names the way the doctor list already sorts them.
Entries are ordered by slot start, earliest first; ties by doctor name.

findings.text: The tie-break collation default ('the way the doctor list already sorts them') is a real assumption, but it sits under Out of scope while assumed is []. The context pack does not document how the doctor list sorts, and same-name ties are left unspecified.
